manifest.meaning: Guest declaration; its id identifies the guest. It is governed by the manifest or own-service-manifest form of appliance.xenia.v1. Alternatively supply source to fetch the manifest.

source.meaning: When manifest is absent, release_repo and optional ref identify the release from which to obtain the manifest.

id.meaning: Optional identity, if present it must equal the manifest id.

slug.meaning: Optional identity, if present it must equal the manifest id.

tabs.meaning: Optional proposed tab row; absent selects a default derived from the manifest.

choices.meaning: Optional choices envelope; enabled and priority here take precedence over the corresponding top-level fields.

changed.meaning: Whether the register, tab, process seat or installation changed.

attempt.meaning: Entry, row and when applicable process-seat attempt.

seat.meaning: Process seat result when one was used.

observed.meaning: Process-seat or prior outcome observation when present.

receipt.meaning: Launcher receipt when present, including on some refusals.

message.meaning: Refusal message; can include runtime error detail.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The handler places refusal tokens and open error detail in message, not firstMissingSignal. The enum lists fixed signal literals supplied by this handler.
